DK92.2 is a medical diagnosis code representing "gastrointestinal bleeding, unspecified" (gastrointestinal blødning UNS) [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system, this code plays a specific and critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment outcomes for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. Specifically, it is utilized as part of a broader set of diagnostic codes to calculate the clinical indicator for the incidence of severe bleeding events among these patients [^src1].

The tracking of severe bleeding is a key quality metric managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) in their national clinical databases [^src1]. To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding, the clinical guidelines employ a wide array of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes. Alongside DK92.2, the gastrointestinal bleeding category includes codes ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], as well as [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] and [[dk92-1|DK92.1]] [^src1]. The comprehensive indicator also tracks intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. 

By standardizing these codes across regions, RKKP ensures consistent data collection and enables comparative quality assessments of cardiovascular care throughout Denmark [^src2]. The precise definition and application of DK92.2 and its associated codes are formally documented in the methodology sections of the annual "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" reports, serving as a technical reference for clinical quality measurement [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
